sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the longitudinal-frame formulas, conditional moment-factor branches, required owners, operands, results, units, expected-result-scaled tolerances, and optional bracket-area exclusion calculation.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace ABS-based tolerance calculations and difference tests with permitted DIRECT_CALCULATION operations, such as IF branches for the sign of each expected result and comparisons against expected-minus-tolerance and expected-plus-tolerance. Encode the conditional exact constant m = 13.3 using equal sh:minInclusive and sh:maxInclusive bounds on frameMomentFactorM/qudt:numericValue rather than the SPARQL inequality test. Also enforce the exception branch: when frameBoundaryConditionType is continuousBeamWithBracketsFrameCondition and significantlyDifferentBoundaryConditions is true, frameMomentFactorM must be smaller than 13.3; do not leave that selected branch unconstrained. Preserve the existing formula operands, expected-result-scaled tolerances, units, longitudinalFrame ownership, and bracket-exclusion calculation.

Retarget the continuous-beam conditional directly on nltl:longitudinalFrame nodes, for example by attaching an sh:or to gen:LongitudinalFrameCalculationShape; do not target the controlled-value individual nltl:continuousBeamWithBracketsFrameCondition and validate owners through an inverse path. Preserve the three cases: non-continuous frames are unaffected, continuous frames with significantlyDifferentBoundaryConditions=false require m exactly 13.3 using equal inclusive bounds, and continuous frames with the selector=true require m<13.3. Also remove sh:minCount 1 from grossFrameShearArea, bracketArea, and actualFrameShearArea because the exclusion rule does not independently require those facts to exist. Restructure the bounded calculation query so absence of those optional exclusion operands cannot suppress validation of f4, sectionModulus, and requiredShearArea; validate actualFrameShearArea=grossFrameShearArea-bracketArea only when all three exclusion values are present. Preserve the existing operands, units, expected-result-scaled tolerances, and longitudinalFrame ownership.

Candidate faithfully encodes the longitudinal-frame formulas, conditional moment-factor branches, required owners, operands, results, units, expected-result-scaled tolerances, and optional bracket-area exclusion calculation.
